template.constraints: Test UK visa invitation letter flow thoroughly. Available cities: Bangalore, North Goa, Mumbai, Chennai, New Delhi.
manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user

variants.name: UK visa - all 5 cities available
variants.goal: Verify all 5 city options (Bangalore, North Goa, Mumbai, Chennai, New Delhi) are shown in the UK visa flow

phases.description: Request a UK visa letter
phases.completionCriteria: Bot presents 5 city options including Bangalore, North Goa, Mumbai, Chennai, New Delhi

phases.description: Select Chennai and complete the visa letter request
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms the UK visa letter request has been raised

variants.name: UK visa - select and go back options
variants.goal: Verify Select and Go Back options work for all cards in the UK visa flow

phases.description: Navigate to the city selection step
phases.completionCriteria: Bot shows city options with Select and Go Back buttons

phases.description: Click Go Back to verify navigation works
phases.completionCriteria: Bot takes user back to the previous step

phases.description: Re-navigate and select a city to complete the flow
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms the visa letter request

variants.name: UK visa edge - name with numbers rejected
variants.goal: Verify bot rejects a name that contains numbers

phases.description: Start UK visa flow and reach the name prompt
phases.completionCriteria: Bot asks for the applicant's name

phases.description: Enter a name with numbers (Geetika123)
phases.completionCriteria: Bot rejects the name and asks for a valid name without numbers

phases.description: Enter a valid name and complete the flow
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms the UK visa letter request

variants.name: UK visa edge - name with numbers and letters rejected
variants.goal: Verify bot rejects a name like 'John123Smith' (name+numbers format)

phases.description: Start UK visa flow and reach name prompt
phases.completionCriteria: Bot asks for the applicant's name

phases.description: Enter 'John123Smith'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot rejects alphanumeric name

phases.description: Provide valid name and complete
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms UK visa letter

variants.name: UK visa edge - invalid passport format rejected
variants.goal: Verify bot only accepts 1-2 letters followed by 6-7 digits for passport number

phases.description: Navigate to passport number prompt
phases.completionCriteria: Bot asks for passport number

phases.description: Enter all-numeric passport '123456789'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot rejects and says passport must be 1-2 letters followed by 6-7 digits

phases.description: Enter valid passport B1234567 and complete
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms UK visa letter request

variants.name: UK visa edge - start date in past rejected
variants.goal: Verify bot rejects a past date as the start date for UK visa

phases.description: Navigate to start date prompt
phases.completionCriteria: Bot asks for travel start date

phases.description: Enter a past date as start date
phases.completionCriteria: Bot rejects the past start date and asks for a future date

phases.description: Enter valid start and end dates and complete the flow
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms UK visa letter request

variants.name: UK visa edge - today's date as start rejected
variants.goal: Verify bot rejects today's date as the start date

phases.description: Navigate to start date prompt
phases.completionCriteria: Bot asks for travel start date

phases.description: Enter today's date as start date
phases.completionCriteria: Bot rejects today's date and asks for a future start date

phases.description: Enter valid future dates and complete
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms UK visa letter request

variants.name: UK visa edge - end date before start date rejected
variants.goal: Verify bot rejects an end date that is before the start date

phases.description: Navigate and provide a valid start date
phases.completionCriteria: Bot accepts start date and asks for end date

phases.description: Enter an end date that is before the start date
phases.completionCriteria: Bot rejects end date that is before start date

phases.description: Enter valid end date and complete
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms UK visa letter request

variants.name: UK visa - free flow natural language
variants.goal: Test various natural language ways to request a UK visa letter

phases.description: Say 'Can you create a visa letter for my UK trip' or 'I need something for UK visa approval'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot recognizes UK visa letter intent and starts the flow
phases.recoveryHint: Try 'uk visa letter chahiye' or 'I need approval letter for UK travel'

phases.description: Complete the UK visa letter request with valid data
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms the UK visa letter request

variants.name: UK visa - Hinglish request
variants.goal: Request UK visa letter in Hinglish

phases.description: Say 'uk visa letter chahiye' or 'uk jaana hai visa letter chahiye'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot understands and starts UK visa flow

phases.description: Complete the UK visa letter with valid data
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms UK visa letter request
